criteria_source: The fixture alone. The mechanism is retry amplification: five attempts per caller multiplies load on an already-failing upstream exactly when it is failing, and the fixed one-second delay synchronizes every client's retries instead of spreading them.
trap: Passes when it names retry amplification - the upstream takes up to five times the traffic while it is already failing - and the fixed delay lining every client's retries up rather than spreading them. Fails when it blames only the 30-second timeout, the exception handling, or proposes a fix without naming the mechanism.
